notes.title: 🎌🎮 We’re at TGS! — Live Demo (Day 1)
notes.content: [h2]🎌🎮 We’re at TGS! — Live Demo (Day 1)[/h2][p][/p][p]Hello from Tokyo Game Show (Makuhari Messe)! The [b]demo is live[/b] at our booth, and we have goodies—stickers, stamp marks, and T‑shirts (limited stock). If you’re at the show, come play; if you’re at home, hit the [b]“Demo”[/b] button on our Steam page and tell us how it goes. 💌[/p][p][/p][p][b]Booth[/b]: Hall 11, stand [b]C62[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]New[/h3][list][*][p][b]Playable demo[/b] at the booth and on Steam.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Goodies[/b]: stickers and stamp marks for players, and [i]T‑shirts[/i] for those who beat the claw challenge (limited).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Booth photo[/b] plus first community impressions throughout the day.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/043164756cf482d98530e4815fce92dcb7c131df.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Meet us at our booth - come say hi![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/77bdbe792a40460566c24dc34dbe084a1767ca1d.png"][/img][/p][p]The rest of the team stayed in [b]Mexico[/b] pushing other projects. [i]Thanks to their support we can be here[/i]. 🙌[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/8dffd02674d25cea4166dff5fee56d8101e78eba.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]How to play the demo on Steam[/h3][list][*][p]Open our game page on Steam.[/p][p]Click the [b]“Demo”[/b] button to download.[/p][p]Share your feedback in this post or on our Hub/Discord.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]How you can help[/h3][list][*][p]Tell us in 1–2 sentences how clear the demo loop feels.[/p][/*][*][p]If you post booth photos, tag the game and let us know if we can repost (it might bring you closer to a T‑shirt!).[/p][/*][*][p]Add us to your [b]Wishlist[/b] and share with someone who might enjoy it. 💖[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Roadmap[/h3][list][*][p]TGS Day 3: best photos and community highlights.[/p][/*][*][p]Post‑show: mini postmortem + demo tuning patch.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: 🎬📅 Pre-TGS — In Tokyo now: booth photos + how to get here (11-C62)
notes.content: [h2]🎬📅 Pre-TGS — Booth photos + how to get here (11-C62)[/h2][p][/p][p]Hello from Chiba! Our [b]trailer[/b] and [b]playable demo[/b] on Steam are already live. Today we’re sharing a look at the booth and a quick route so you won’t get lost. The weather is lovely—perfect for a stroll around Makuhari. 💛[/p][p][/p][h3]Chiba, the host city[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/a40712323bfddf35c5c31e0148e5fa23ed06b073.png"][/img][/p][h3]Our booth[/h3][p]Hall [b]11[/b], booth [b]C62[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/77bdbe792a40460566c24dc34dbe084a1767ca1d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/8070ae2a2fa1751adec6bc9c82cc644e68171f1e.png"][/img][/p][h3]How to get here (quick & clear)[/h3][list][*][p][b]From Tokyo Station[/b]: JR Keiyō Line (~30 min) to [b]Kaihin-Makuhari[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]On foot[/b]: ~5 min via the raised walkway to [i]International Exhibition Hall 9–11[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]By bus[/b]: from Makuhari-Hongō (JR Sōbu/Keisei) to Makuhari Messe (~15–17 min).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/1cb1f31d9596c6ab6964533ab68d2ff3acf3f2e1.png"][/img][/p][h3]Team on site[/h3][p][b]Isa, Román, René, and Will[/b]. Huge thanks to the team in [b]Mexico[/b] pushing other projects back home. 💛[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/28cb52bc896e857e5b7a6235a7df2e8bb1cd1df9.png"][/img][/p][h3]Remember[/h3][list][*][p][b]Trailer[/b]: watch it on the store page.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Playable demo[/b] on Steam: fishing, decoration (magnet), diorama view, and board.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Booth goodies[/b]: stickers and limited T‑shirts for those who beat the claw challenge. 💪🧲[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]How you can help[/h3][list][*][p]In 1–2 lines, tell us how clearly the demo loop reads to you.[/p][/*][*][p]Add us to your [b]Wishlist[/b] and share the trailer with a friend. 💖[/p][/*][/list][h3]Roadmap[/h3][list][*][p]TGS Day 1: live post from the floor + first impressions.[/p][/*][*][p]TGS Day 3: best photos and community highlights.[/p][/*][*][p]Post‑show: short postmortem + demo polish patch.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🧊🎧 Marble Station — EP (OUT NOW)
notes.content: [h2]🧊🎧 Marble Station — EP (OUT NOW)[/h2][p][/p][p]We’re celebrating the release of the [b]“Marble Station” EP[/b] — three cozy pieces that capture our Japanese diorama’s pulse: gentle rhythms, sweet textures, and that playful [i]claw[/i] heartbeat. It drops on [b]Friday, September 19[/b], just 6 days before Tokyo Game Show (Sep 25–28). 💗[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/d5411c49cfa485ea860a67142bebac6404925be1.png"][/img][/p][h3]Listen now[/h3][p][url="https://onerpm.link/531193321035"]🎧 Smart link[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Tracklist[/h3][list][*][p]1) Clawby Bubblegum (Main Theme)[/p][/*][*][p]2) Clawby Soda Pop[/p][/*][*][p]3) Marble Bay[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Artwork & process[/h3][p]We’re sharing the cover and a few process sketches from Marble Station’s visual path.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/92b4d404a8c428dccff050334c93e84c3e0640e2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/e13014d6d1082933ae20fb82d6f04dd2c2bc04b1.png"][/img][/p][h3]Credits[/h3][list][*][p]Music composed & produced by Alejandro Solís Muñoz[/p][/*][*][p]Cover art by [url="http://instagram.com/reneshotss"]René Velazquez @reneshotss[/url] (Art Director, Cometa Games)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bonus: demo + TGS[/h3][p]The [b]playable demo[/b] is live on Steam with a trailer. If you’re coming to TGS, visit us at Hall [b]11[/b], booth [b]C62[/b].[/p][p]Thanks for listening — and for every [b]Wishlist[/b]. It helps a lot. 💖[/p]

notes.title: 🚀🎮 Trailer + Demo Launch
notes.content: [h2]🚀🎮 Trailer + Demo Launch (Steam)[/h2][p][/p][p]Today we launch the [b]playable demo[/b] and drop its [b]trailer[/b]! It features four pillars of the vertical slice: the [i]fishing mission[/i], [i]Decoration Mode (magnet)[/i], [i]diorama view[/i], and [i]board mode[/i] for collecting/unlocking. If you like what you see, add us to your [b]Wishlist[/b] and share your first impressions. 💗[/p][p][/p][h3]Trailer[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="7uBl9USCZug;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Available today[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fishing mission[/b]: a short, clear loop to learn the basics (this is our baseline for future missions—tell us how it feels and how we can improve it).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Decoration Mode (magnet)[/b]: move/place objects with an energy‑particle “tether” and [b]3D dust on landing[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Diorama view[/b]: stroll through “Marble Station” and enjoy the details.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Board mode[/b]: collect and [i]unlock[/i] objects for your diorama.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collectibles[/b]: 40+ items (urban props, plants, signage).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Support[/b]: Steam Deck, gamepad + keyboard (basic mapping).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]How to play the demo on Steam[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Go to the game’s Steam page.[/p][/*][*][p]Click the [b]“Demo”[/b] button to download.[/p][/*][*][p]Share feedback in this post or on our Hub/Discord. 💌[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Tokyo Game Show[/h3][list][*][p][b]Dates[/b]: September 25–28.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Location[/b]: Hall [b]11[/b], booth [b]C62[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Drop by for stickers and—if you beat the claw challenge—[i]shirts[/i] (limited stock).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bonus: official music[/h3][p][/p][p]Our demo single is out now: [b]“Clawby Bubble Gum”[/b]. Listen here → [url="https://onerpm.link/304014370447"]🎧 Smart link[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]How you can help[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Tell us if the trailer’s three beats communicate the game’s essence.[/p][/*][*][p]Which mode do you like most: fishing, decoration, diorama or board?[/p][/*][*][p]Add us to your [b]Wishlist[/b] and share the trailer with a friend.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Roadmap[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]During TGS: live post from the booth + first community impressions.[/p][/*][*][p]Post‑show: mini postmortem + demo tuning patch.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Note[/i]: the demo content is WIP; we prioritize stability and clear readability. Thanks for playing![/p]

notes.title: 🧊 Demo Freeze — What’s in the TGS build
notes.content: [h2]🧊 Demo Freeze — What’s in the TGS build [/h2][p]Hi! We’re entering a [b]feature freeze[/b] for the demo we’ll release on September 15 on Steam and also take to Tokyo Game Show. Here’s the final scope, what stays out to keep stability, and how you can help with your feedback at the event.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/1a1333c97247608a6d0e5e958e451cc23d827b57.gif"][/img] [/p][h3]Included in the demo (TGS build)[/h3][list][*][p] [b]Fishing mission[/b]: a short, clear loop to learn the basics.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Decoration Mode (magnet)[/b]: move/place objects; energy lines and 3D dust on landing.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Diorama view[/b]: walk through the Japanese diorama (Marble Street) and enjoy the details.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Board mode[/b]: collect and [i]unlock[/i] objects for the Japanese diorama (Marble Street).[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Initial collectibles[/b]: 40+ items across urban props, plants, and signage.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Controller support[/b]: gamepad + keyboard (basic mapping).[/p][/*][/list][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/c6f40c44fe7c317ccfef0f358c05ec16b0f5a78f.gif"][/img] [/p][h3]Out of scope (for now)[/h3][list][*][p] New dioramas.[/p][/*][*][p] Additional missions beyond fishing. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/209a03a57e565bd5d766944803544867ec609800.gif"][/img] [/p][h3]How you can help[/h3][list][*][p] Try the four modes and tell us what reads in ~10s and what doesn’t.[/p][/*][*][p] Leave quick impressions (timing, clarity, accessibility) at the booth or in the comments.[/p][/*][*][p] Add us to your [b]Wishlist[/b] and share the demo with someone who might enjoy it.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Roadmap[/h3][list][*][p] Pre‑TGS: [b]mini trailer[/b] of the demo with fishing, decoration, diorama view, and board.[/p][/*][*][p] Day 1 of the show: live post from the booth + first impressions.[/p][/*][*][p] Post‑show: mini postmortem + patch with demo adjustments.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][i]Note[/i]: scope may receive minor tweaks up to show day; we prioritize stability and a clear loop read. Thanks for being with us![/p]

notes.title: 💫🧲 Devlog #03 — Decoration Mode + VFX (Demo Sep 15)
notes.content: [h2]💫🧲 Devlog #03 — Decoration Mode + VFX (Demo Sep 15)[/h2][p][b]Heads-up:[/b] a [b]new demo lands on Sep 15[/b], featuring this Decoration Mode plus more.[/p][p]Today we’re debuting the [b]Decoration Mode[/b]. A [i]magnet[/i] lets you grab objects and place them anywhere, with an energy-particle tether. When they land, a [b]3D dust VFX[/b] plays. The system [b]saves[/b] each object’s position and you can [b]reset[/b] the diorama anytime.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/4a97344ee947a81a03feef03ee1a1119e4508375.gif"][/img][/p][h3]New[/h3][list][*][p] Decoration magnet: attract and move objects freely; place them precisely.[/p][/*][*][p] Energy particles: a visual “tether” follows the grab and movement.[/p][/*][*][p] 3D dust on landing: particles spawn on impact for weight and detail (integration WIP).[/p][/*][*][p] Save & reset: the diorama remembers positions; button to restore the default layout.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/44803631fe51e631f26de76879c7b383cdcc4b69.gif"][/img][/p][h3]How it works[/h3][list][*][p] Position Clawby over the object you want to move.[/p][/*][*][p] Press [b]A[/b] to lower Clawby and stick the object to the magnet.[/p][/*][*][p] Adjust rotation with the controller bumpers.[/p][/*][*][p] The system auto-saves your composition; you can reset anytime.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/aa7b96b8abcab06845e8476fa5d716d32dcd73b8.gif"][/img][/p][h3]VFX & detail[/h3][list][*][p] Energy lines are soft and readable at mid-distance.[/p][/*][*][p] 3D dust triggers on impact to reinforce object weight.[/p][/*][*][p] Duration/size/density tuned to avoid visual noise.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/16eb681b85b966cb860694166c3794902f0db074.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Bugs & fixes (demo status)[/h3][list][*][p] Edge-case collisions to avoid clipping on release.[/p][/*][*][p] Pivot pass on some props for a cleaner initial grab.[/p][/*][*][p] Persistence checks in heavy scenes (WIP).[/p][/*][/list][h3]How you can help[/h3][list][*][p] Would you like a per-object reset in addition to full reset?[/p][/*][*][p] Which category should we prioritize: plants, furniture, signage, or “treasures”?[/p][/*][/list][h3]Roadmap[/h3][list][*][p] [b]Sep 15[/b]: new demo build — fishing mission, Decoration Mode, diorama view mode, and the board mode for collecting/unlocking.[/p][/*][*][p] Next post: 🧊 Demo Freeze — what’s in the TGS booth build.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Note[/i]: everything is WIP; names and art may change as we iterate.[/p]

notes.title: 🎨 Art Drop #2 — TGS art (booth concepts & look)
notes.content: [h2]🎨 Art Drop #2 — TGS art (booth concepts & look)[/h2][p][/p][p]Hello! Today we’re sharing a peek at the art we’re bringing to Tokyo Game Show: the [i]key art[/i] you’ll see on our cards/socials, plus booth concepts with ambience. By the way, among other surprises, we’re also making a PC version of My Dear Farm—our beloved mobile game is coming to PC. [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3937950/My_Dear_Farm/"]Add MDF to your wishlist here[/url].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/73042c2d888865ffec83eff52db5c903e970e78e.png"][/img][/p][h3]New[/h3][list][*] TGS key art.[*] Booth concepts: layout, color keys, and access signage.[*] Concepts for exclusive giveaway shirts at Tokyo Game Show.[*] Concepts for giveaway stickers at Tokyo Game Show.[*] Props/branding: stickers, shirts, postcards, and table items.[/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/e09deacc9ad1f08d022f0fe22ee430c14b3b80d9.png"][/img][/p][h3]Booth design (WIP)[/h3][list][*] Clear path: entrance → diorama → hands‑on → photo.[*] Warm palette and readable type in a noisy show floor.[*] Materials and lighting tuned for quick readability.[/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/efb335fd61173fdd625b16a83e0371c8c81bb9d5.png"][/img][/p][h3]How you can help[/h3][list][*] Vote which piece to print: sticker, postcard, or mini poster.[*] What booth detail is a must? Signage/prop ideas welcome.[/list][h3]Roadmap[/h3][list][*] Next: Devlog #03 — Animation + VFX (rhythm & feel).[*] Pre‑TGS: demo mini‑trailer + booth schedule.[/list][p][i]Note[/i]: everything is WIP; art and names may change as we iterate on the demo.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/7a2669b2afa42adcfd867bc40b7483da65e29908.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🧱✨ Devlog #02 — From blockout to high poly (Japanese diorama)
notes.content: [h2]🧱✨ Devlog #02 — From blockout to high poly (Japanese diorama)[/h2][p][/p][p]Hello! In this devlog we go from [i]blockout[/i] to [i]model[/i] (and bake) using real props from the Japanese diorama: the vending machine, the mini‑truck and the signage. Goal: correct scale and clear mid‑distance readability.[/p][p][/p][h3]3‑step process[/h3][list][*] Blockout: big shapes, silhouette, pivot and scale using real‑world refs.[*] Model: clean bevels and surface continuity for readable highlights.[*] Bake & low: projection checks to avoid artifacts.[/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/9fca9f743d7fdabc55f6b748b961d56738cb617c.png"][/img][/p][h3]Bugs & Fixes (demo status)[/h3][list][*] Normal fixes after bake on curved surfaces (WIP).[*] Simplified collisions for smooth navigation in the diorama.[/list][h3]How you can help[/h3][list][*] Vote the next prop to deep‑dive: vending / mini‑truck / signage / bench.[*] Share texture references (photos or ideas) in the comments.[/list][h3]Roadmap[/h3][list][*] Next: Art Drop #2 — we’ll show special TGS art (shirts, stickers, exclusive pieces) and more game concept art.[/list][p][i]Note[/i]: everything shown is WIP; art and names may change as we iterate on the demo.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/f4abdd0d70124f8eae90ab210d904fb9af6fc923.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/e99f9ea8e8b6b254d44e71b74705a53f798ab3aa.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎏🏮🐕 Art Drop #1 — Japanesse Diorama for the new demo (40+ new objects)
notes.content: [h2]🎏🏮🐕 Art Drop #1 — Japanese diorama for the demo (40+ unlockable items)[/h2][p]Hello! Today we’re sharing a cozy look at the concept art for our official demo diorama—a small Japanese street corner made to stroll, decorate, and discover details.[/p][p]This set comes with over 40 unlockable items (WIP): plants, lanterns, benches, signs, vending machines, boxes, poles, shop signs, and little surprises.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/d047206ca586076e2ff38e6372cb2ebdaabebe9b.png"][/img][/p][h3]New[/h3][list][*] “Japanese neighborhood” diorama: street, small plaza, charming facades.[*] Everyday life: a courier, neighbors, and a curious dog. Some elements interact with the world so the scene feels alive.[*] Tiny truck and urban props to set the vibe.[/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/733efc43f79acb75962da08830407278fd7762f0.png"][/img][/p][h3]Diorama & collectibles (WIP)[/h3][list][*] Decoration: planters, shrubs, lanterns, benches, fences, cones.[*] Commerce: signs, awnings, shop boards, illustrated menus.[*] Urban: streetlight, road signs, mailbox, bins, boxes, barriers.[/list][h3]How you can help[/h3][list][*] Tell us which items should be unlockable on day one.[*] Which interaction excites you most—the dog, the vending machine, or the truck?[*] Share your favorite references (photos or ideas) in the comments.[/list][p]Note: everything shown is WIP; names and art may change as we iterate on the demo.[/p]

notes.title: 🌸🎡🐾 Devlog #01 — “Thanks 10k” + We’re going to TGS! 💌
notes.content:

Thank you for the love — it powers the final push on the demo. ✨[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524842/5c1211952907d8e5fd279c3acc1f1b948011f66b.png"][/img]
